messages:
deploy-bot: Starting container image build for service=payment-proxy env=prod commit=3a7f9d2 tag=cicd-2026-03-20-3a7f9d2
alice: great, kicking off release window 21:00-22:00UTC, FYI to SRE and oncall
ben: observed higher latency on the mirror earlier, will keep an eye on push backpressure
registry-bot: build 3a7f9d2: stage=artifact-upload status=uploading to gcr.redwood.io/redwood/payment-proxy:prod-3a7f9d2
registry-bot: upload failed: 409 CONFLICT digest exists on target manifest, attempting dedup fallback
carla: 409 on push — is this a duplicate tag race or a digest mismatch?
ben: looks like another pipeline pushed the same tag from canary, digests differ. starting fallback push with immutable digest suffix
registry-bot: retry push as gcr.redwood.io/redwood/payment-proxy:prod-3a7f9d2-001 status=uploading
registry-bot: upload complete, size=74.2MB, status=success
dave: can we signature-verify before rolling out? remember the signing proxy had a small timeout earlier
registry-bot: queued signing job job_id=sign-7621 status=started
registry-bot: signing job sign-7621 status=complete signature=sha256:fa4b...
alice: ok, new image pushed and signed. proposing canary rollout to 2 nodes in prod with 5-minute observation. link to release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20/payment-proxy
carla: put a pin on the canary tag in the console so Dedicated customers don't receive the canary variant automatically. I'll create the pin now
carla: pin created: modelRouting.pin:image=payment-proxy:prod-3a7f9d2-001 scope=public->excluded,dedicated->pinned
ben: SRE: I'll watch GPU and gRPC error rates during the canary. @dave please escalate if token errors >0.5%
dave: ack, oncall monitoring set. ephemeral alert if 5xx spike or latency > 250ms p95
alice: after 10m green, we proceed to gradual rollout 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 40m. if regressions, we roll back to previous image prod-2026-03-15-9f2b1c (pinned)
carla: adding release note blurb re: registry dedupe fallback and pin decision
carla: finalizing changelog and will update the release dashboard once full rollout completes
alice: thanks team, will post a follow-up when 100% done :thumbsup:
registry-bot: lifecycle: canary-deploy started target=2 nodes rollout_policy=canary
registry-bot: canary health status=healthy at=+6m metrics:5xx=0.0% p95=142ms
alice: looks good so far
registry-bot: canary roll forward to 25% at=+12m
registry-bot: rollout complete 100% at=+52m status=success
alice: completed rollout, tagging release prod-release-2026-03-20-3a7f9d2, closing window
dave: verified no alerts during window. marking oncall clear
carla: note: kept the pinned previous image for Dedicated customers per policy
alice: closing thread. thanks everyone! :party_popper:
